items.title: 68098_Snub Mosley oral history interview
items.q: we always called her Miss Mary and she heard the band and persuaded Mr. E--- to give us a tryout

ctx.x: Great big German fellow. Anyway she came out, we always called her Miss Mary and she heard the band and persuaded Mr. E--- to give us a tryout. Then we went down and tried out and he gave us a two week contract.
